programme.desc: ‫‫تقع خادمة المنزل والمخلصة لكريشنا بالاماني في حب حفيد سيدتها مانو، وعندما تعارض العائلة بأكملها زواجهما، استنجدت بالأماني بالرب ليجعلها تنساه.‬‬ Balamani, a housemaid and a devotee of Krishna, falls in love with her mistress's grandson, Manu. When the whole family is against their union, Balamani seeks the lord's help to make her forget him.

programme.title: آراباكاتها - Arabikkatha
programme.desc: ‫‫يقوم الشيوعي المتشدد موكوندان بفضح فظائع السياسي كارونان، إلا أن المجتمع يرفضه بسبب آرائه التي عفى عليها الزمان.‬‬ Mukundan, a staunch communist, exposes politician Karunan's atrocities. However, society rejects him for his outdated views.

programme.title: دريشيام ٢ - Drishyam 2
programme.desc: ‫‫يمتلك جورجكوتي صاحب المزاج المتقلب دار سينما خاصة به، ويحاول تحقيقي النجاح في حياته بطريقة باهرة. مع ذلك، عندما تتورط عائلته في تحقيق جنائي، يجب عليه حمايتها من المؤسسة القانونية.‬‬ Georgekutty, a cinema hall owner, is a changed man who thrives in life. However, when his family become entangled in a criminal investigation, he must protect them from the legal institution.

programme.title: ثريسور بورام - Thrissur Pooram
programme.desc: ‫‫يحاول رب الأسرة بولو غيري أن يعيش حياة هادئة وينسى ماضيه الإجرامي، لكنه يجر مرة أخرى إلى شبكة إجرامية يملؤها الشر، بسبب حادث وقع في بلدته الأم.‬‬ Pullu Giri is trying to live a peaceful life and forget his ruffian past. Following an incident, he gets dragged into the affairs of some local gangs.

programme.title: كريستشن برذرز - Christian Brothers
programme.desc: ‫‫تتعرض ابنة أحد الوزراء للاختطاف، فيتم استدعاء الشاب كريستي لإنقاذها. على الرغم من تمكن كريستي من إنقاذ الفتاة، إلا أنه يتورط في جريمة قتل الخاطف.‬‬ When the daughter of a minister gets kidnapped, Christy is called upon to rescue her. Although he manages to save her, he himself gets embroiled in the kidnapper's murder.

programme.title: نادوديمانان - Nadodimannan
programme.desc: ‫‫ينضم بادمانابهان إلى عدد من التكتلات السياسية لكسب المال، ولكنه يقع في مشكلة عندما يتم انتخابه رئيسا لبلدية ثيروفانانثابورام ويضطر إلى محاربة الفساد في المدينة.‬‬ Padmanabhan, a man who joins political rallies to make money, gets into trouble when he is elected mayor of Thiruvananthapuram and is forced to fight corruption in the city.

programme.title: آي.جي. - I.G.
programme.desc: ‫‫يتم تعيين المفتش العام دورغا براساد رئيسا لفرقة مكافحة الإرهاب، لكنه لا يلبث أن يوضع أمام مفترق طرق صعب يلزمه بالاختيار بين أسرته ومهامه الوظيفية إثر انكشاف حقيقة صادمة.‬‬ Inspector General Durga Prasad gets appointed as the head of an an anti-terrorism squad. However, a revelation soon forces him to choose between his family and his duty.

programme.title: بوليمان - Pulliman
programme.desc: ‫‫كانجوني شاب يتيم يقع في حب فتاة تدعى رادها، إلا أن والدها يرفض ارتباطهما. يكتشف كانجوني أنه ينتمي لعائلة ثرية.‬‬ Kunjunni, an orphan, and Radha, who makes a living by selling statues of deities, love each other. However, problems arise when her father opposes their relationship.

programme.title: أورو يامندان بريما كادا - Oru Yamandan Premakadha
programme.desc: ‫‫لالو شخص سعيد الحظ يحب التسكع مع أصدقائه ويسعى وراء الحب الحقيقي. في أحد الأيام، يجد صورة لامرأة مفقودة تدعى ديا في الصحيفة ويشعر أن قلبه بدأ يخفق حبا.‬‬ Lallu, a happy-go-lucky person who loves to hang out with his friends, is in pursuit of true love. One day, he finds a photo of a missing woman, Diya, in the newspaper and feels a spark.

programme.title: تهالايانامنترم - Thalayana Manthram
programme.desc: ‫‫فيلم من بطولة سرينيفسن وأورفاشي وبارفاتي مانوم وجايرام وكاباك لاليتا وماموكويا ومينا وسوكوماري وسانكارادي وأودوفيل أونيكريشنان وجاغديش وبرافور بهارتهان ومن إخراج سايتهان أنكيد.‬‬ After marriage, Sukumaran's wife Kanchana demands a glamorous lifestyle. However, Sukumaran, who finds it difficult to fulfil her wishes, takes a loan which he is later unable to repay.

programme.title: آدو ٢ - Aadu 2
programme.desc: ‫‫يحتاج شاجي بابان إلى المال من أجل نادي الفن الخاص به، ولإيجاد حل لذلك يشارك شاجي وأصدقاؤه في مسابقة شد الحبل للفوز بالجائزة الكبرى.‬‬ Shaji Pappan and his team participate in a tug-of-war tournament to overcome their financial crisis. However, fate entangles them in a counterfeiting deal.

programme.title: إي باراكوم تاليكا - Ee Parakkum Thalika
programme.desc: ‫‫يجرب مالك الحافلة أوني العديد من الطرق لتحسين وضع حافلته التي تحمل اسم والده الراحل، لكن الأمور تأخذ منعطفا جديدا عندما تدخل ابنة أحد رجال السياسة النافذين حياته.‬‬ Unni, a bus owner, tries several ways to improve the condition of his bus, which is named after his late father. Things take a turn when the daughter of a powerful politician enters his life.

programme.title: ثينمافين كومباثو - Thenmavin Kombathu
programme.desc: ‫‫يقع سريكرشنان وصديقه الحميم مانيكام في حب ذات الفتاة التي تعمل ممثلة في القرية، لكن سريكرشنان مصمم بشكل أكبر من صديقه على الفوز بقلبها، الأمر الذي يؤدي إلى تدهور صداقتهما.‬‬ A young man unwittingly falls for his best friend's lover. However, the ensuing love triangle threatens to ruin their childhood bond of friendship.

programme.title: ثناير ماثان دينانغل - Thanneermathan Dinangal
programme.desc: ‫‫يشعر المراهق جايسون بالإعجاب تجاه كيرثي التي لا تبادله المشاعر. يتورط في مشكلة مع المعلم الجديد رافي الذي يحبه الجميع خصوصا كيرثي، ما يزيد الأمور سوءا.‬‬ Jaison, a teenager, has a crush on Keerthy, but she does not reciprocate his feelings. To make things worse, he gets in trouble with Ravi, the new teacher who is liked by everyone, especially Keerthy.

programme.title: أيودهام - Aayudham
programme.desc: ‫‫يحدث انفجار قوي على شاطئ فيلايام بعد ثوان من مغادرة رئيس الوزراء مادهافان المكان، فيتم تكليف ضابط الشرطة ريشيكيش بالتحقيق لمعرفة الحقيقة وراء الانفجار.‬‬ When a powerful explosion occurs at the Vilayam beach seconds after Chief Minister Madhavan leaves the venue, Police Officer Rishikesh is tasked with the investigation to find the truth behind the blast.

programme.title: مالايالي - Malayali
programme.desc: ‫‫يحظى مادهافان بحب واحترام جميع سكان القرية باستثناء عدد من أشقائه الذين يكرهونه. تزداد الأمور سوءا بعد أن يحاول أشقاؤه توريطه زورا في قضية قتل أحد معارفه.‬‬ Madhavan is loved and respected by everyone in the village except his brothers who hate him. Matters get worse after his brothers try to falsely implicate him in an acquaintance's murder case.

programme.title: لف آكشن دراما - Love Action Drama
programme.desc: ‫‬ Dinesh, a conceited and wealthy young bachelor, goes to extreme lengths to impress a girl named Shobha with the help of his best friend Sagar, and Dinesh eventually hopes to marry Shobha.

programme.title: يودايانانيو ثارام - Udayananu Tharam
programme.desc: ‫‫يعاني مساعد مخرج الأمرين بعد أن يصبح شريكه في السكن مشهورا، بسبب سرقته لنص فيلمه. يبدأ مساعد المخرج بالتخطيط للانتقام من شريكه على ما فعل به.‬‬ A struggling director gets cheated by his friend who steals his script and becomes a famous actor. However, when he finally gets the chance to direct a film, he is forced to cast a dubious actor.

programme.title: هريدايام - Hridayam
programme.desc: ‫‫يلتحق الشاب آرون بكلية هندسة، لكنه يقع فريسة لعادات سيئة. عندما يكبر، يقرر فتح صفحة جديدة ويصبح شخصا راشدا مسؤولا.‬‬ Arun, a young man, enrols in an engineering college but falls prey to bad habits. As he grows up, he decides to turn over a new leaf and become a responsible adult.

programme.title: آدي كابياري كوتاماني - Adi Kapyare Koottamani
programme.desc: ‫‫تعرض لاكشمي مبلغا من المال على الطالب بهانوبراساد على أمل دخول سكن الجامعة والخروج منه دون أن يلاحظها أحد، لكنها تجد نفسها عالقة في المبنى بسبب سلسلة من الأحداث الفوضوية.‬‬ Lakshmi, hoping to enter and exit the college hostel unnoticed, offers Bhanuprasad, a student, a sum of money. However, she ends up trapped in the building due to a series of chaotic events.

programme.title: بريمالو - Premalu
programme.desc: ‫‫يقع الشاب ساشين في حب الفتاة رينو التي يلتقيها في حفل زفاف، ويشرع في مهمة للفوز بقلبها بعد أن يتم رفض إقامة علاقة معه من قبا إحداهن.‬‬ Having been rejected once, Sachin, a young man, falls for Reenu, a girl he meets during a wedding, and sets out to win her over.

programme.title: فيتنام كولوني - Vietnam Colony
programme.desc: ‫‫يعين الشاب كريشنامورثي من قبل شركة عقارية لإخلاء السكان من مجمع فيتنامي بحجة امتلائه بعناصر غير قانونية، لكنه يكتشف أن الشركة تظلم السكان.‬‬ A real estate company appoints Krishnamurthy to vacate a colony, claiming it is filled with anti-social elements. He gradually realises that the company is being unjust to its residents.

programme.title: كاكي - Kakki
programme.desc: ‫‫يشرع شقيقان يعملان لصالح الشرطة في مهمة لمحاربة مجموعة من المجرمين، وذلك بعدما يثير أحدهم غضبهما بشدة.‬‬ A pair of siblings, both police officers, embark on a mission to fight against some criminals after one of them incurs their wrath.

programme.title: نوفيل - Novel
programme.desc: ‫‫يروي الكاتب الناجح سيثوناث قصة حياته للصحفية أنيسا. يتحدث عن حبه لبريا وعدم قدرته على الزواج منها بسبب زوجته السابقة مانجو.‬‬ Sethunath is a successful writer who shares the story of his life with journalist Aneesa. He talks about falling in love with Priya and his inability to marry her because of his estranged wife, Manju.

programme.title: ون - One
programme.desc: ‫‫يتم اختبار ولاء رجل سياسية صالح لمعتقداته وثوابته الراسخة بطريقة مؤلمة بعد توجيه بعض الادعاءات الخطيرة ضده.‬‬ A righteous politician's unflinching loyalty to his ideologies is sorely tested after some false allegations are levelled against him.

programme.title: كيليتشوندن مامبازهام - Kilichundan Mambazham
programme.desc: ‫‫يعود مويدوكوتي حاجي إلى قريته بعد أن تزوج للمرة الثالثة، على الرغم من رفض زوجتيه الأولى والثانية. مع ذلك، لا يدرك مويدوكوتي أن عروسه الجديدة الشابة الجميلة أمينة تحب سرا بائع الخلاخيل عبدو.‬‬ Moidukutty Haji returns to his village after taking a third wife, despite his other wives' disapproval. Unbeknownst to him, his young and beautiful new bride, Amina, is secretly in love with Abdu, a bangle seller.

programme.title: كيشو إي فيدينتي نادان - Keshu Ee Veedinte Nadhan
programme.desc: ‫‫تنقلب حياة السائق العادي كيشو رأسا على عقب عندما يربح بطاقة يانصيب بقيمة ١٢ كرور، وبناء على ذلك يتم اختبار أخلاقه.‬‬ The life of an ordinary driver Keshu turns upside down when he wins a lottery worth 12 crores but his morality gets tested.

programme.title: مينال مورالي - Minnal Murali
programme.desc: ‫‫يتعرض الشاب جيسون الذي يعمل خياطا لصاعقة من جراء البرق، الأمر الذي يجعله يكتسب قوى خارقة. مع ذلك، يجب عليه إحباط النوايا الشريرة لخصم غير متوقع ليصبح البطل الخارق الذي تحتاجه قريته الريفية.‬‬ Jaison, a young tailor, gains superpowers after being struck by lightning. However, he must thwart the evil intentions of an unexpected adversary to become the superhero that his rural village needs.

programme.title: ماي بوس - My Boss
programme.desc: ‫‫تطلب بريا من مساعدها مانو أن يتظاهر بأنه خطيبها لتضمن ترقيتها، وبسبب إحباطه من معاملتها القاسية، يوافق مانو على ذلك لينتقم منها بطريقته المرحة.‬‬ Priya asks her assistant, Manu, to pretend to be her fiance to secure a promotion. Already frustrated with her cruel treatment, Manu accepts the offer to take revenge in his own humorous way.

programme.title: هاركريشنانس - Harikrishnans
programme.desc: ‫‫يقتل محاضر جامعي يدعى غوبتان، وتشتبه الشرطة بغابريل على أنه القاتل. تقوم شقيقة غابريل بالاستعانة بمحاميين شهيرين كي يثبتا برائته.‬‬ When Guptan, a college lecturer, gets killed, the police suspect Gabriel to be the murderer. A girl takes help from her brothers, who are famous lawyers, in proving his innocence.

programme.title: أنور - Anwar
programme.desc: ‫‫تتسبب ظروف بإجبار أنور على الانضمام إلى منظمة إرهابية، لكن الأمور تتغير عندما يخونها انتقاما لمقتل أفراد عائلته.‬‬ Circumstances force Anwar to join a terrorist organisation. However, things change when he double-crosses them to avenge the death of his family.

programme.title: موتهودوموتهو - Muthodumuthu
programme.desc: ‫‫تعيش الفتاة اليتيمة أشيمول حياة سعيدة مع والديها بالتبني. تنقلب حياتها رأسا على عقب عندما تقع في حب أنيل الذي يعاملها بمثابة شقيقة له.‬‬ Achimol, an orphan, leads a happy life with her step-parents. Her life takes a turn when she falls in love with Anil, who treats her like a sister.

programme.title: ديفي ماتاميام - Devi Mahathmyam
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح726 : ‫مختارات من القصص التي تتناول الأساطير والخرافات المتعلقة بالإلهة دورجا، إلى جانب حكايات أشكالها ومظاهرها المختلفة.‬‬ S1 , E726 : An anthology of stories which deal with the legends and myths related to Goddess Durga, along with the tales of her various forms and manifestations.

programme.title: ماهابهارات - Mahabharatham
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح248 : ‫يؤدي صراع سلالي بين الفروع الجانبية لعشيرة كورو، وهما بكورافاس وباندافاس على عرش هاستينابور إلى حرب كوروكشترا.‬‬ S1 , E248 : A dynastic struggle between the collateral branches of the Kuru clan, the Kauravas and Pandavas, for the throne of Hastinapur leads to the Kurukshetra War.

programme.title: تشانغاثيبوتشا - Changathipoocha
programme.desc: ‫‬ Brothers Sreedharan and Raman are embroiled in a bitter feud over their ancestral property. In a bid to consolidate all the wealth, Raman hires Sivankutty to woo Sreedharan's daughter.

programme.title: كلوكيل بامبارام - Kilukil Pambaram
programme.desc: ‫‫تقوم الحكومة بتعيين أنانثا في وظيفة العناية بالقصر وموجوداته، بعد أن يقتل الوريث الشرعي للقصر وحدوث نزاعات حول من سيخلفه. يحارب أنانثا بكامل طاقته لضمان أن يصل القصر وموجوداته إلى الأيدي الصحيحة.‬‬ As the new caretaker of a palace that is under dispute over its ownership, Anantha, an advocate, must ensure the property remains safe.

programme.title: أنوباندهام - Anubandham
programme.desc: ‫‫تنقلب حياة الأرملة الفقيرة سوناندا رأسا على عقب بعد التحاقها بروضة أطفال بمساعدة معجبها الصامت. مع ذلك، تتعقد الأمور بسبب حادثة مأساوية.‬‬ The life of Sunandha, a poor widow, turns around after she starts a kindergarten with the help of her silent admirer. But things become complicated because of a tragic event.

programme.title: ماهابهارات - Mahabharatham
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح249 : ‫يؤدي صراع سلالي بين الفروع الجانبية لعشيرة كورو، وهما بكورافاس وباندافاس على عرش هاستينابور إلى حرب كوروكشترا.‬‬ S1 , E249 : A dynastic struggle between the collateral branches of the Kuru clan, the Kauravas and Pandavas, for the throne of Hastinapur leads to the Kurukshetra War.

programme.title: إيتو جانما كالبانيل - Eatho Janma Kalpanayil
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح152 : ‫تلتقي الفتاة المرحة سروثي والتي تنتمي من عائلة متواضعة صدفة برجل الأعمال الثري المتغطرس أشوين، وسرعان ما ينشأ الحب بينهما.‬‬ S1 , E152 : Love blooms between Sruthy, a cheerful girl from a humble background and Ashwin, an arrogant wealthy businessman when they accidentally come across each other.

programme.title: تشاندريكايل أليونو تشاندراكانتام - Chandrikayil Aliyunnu Chandrakantham
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح153 : ‫يتزوج ضابط الشرطة غوتام من الطبيبة الطموحة ألاكاناندا رغما عنه، لكن عندما تعود حبيبته الأولى إلى حياته، يجبر على الاختيار بين ماضيه ومستقبله.‬‬ S1 , E153 : Gautham, an IPS officer, is forced to marry Alakananda, an aspiring doctor. However, when his first love reenters his life, he is forced to choose between his past and his future.

programme.title: توفالسبارشام - Thoovalsparsham
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح152 : ‫تتفرق شقيقتان في طفولتهما إثر جريمة قتل تقع في العائلة. بينما تكبر إحداهما لتصبح ضابطة شرطة، تسلك الأخرى طريق الجرائم الصغيرة لكسب عيشها.‬‬ S1 , E152 : Two sisters are separated during their childhood due to a murder in the family. While one becomes a police officer, the other turns to petty crime for a living.

programme.title: باداتا بينكيلي - Paadatha Painkili
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح152 : ‫تواجه امرأة شابة عذابا وقمعا مستمرا من عائلتها المتشددة، لكنها تظل صامدة في بحثها عن الحب والسعادة وتصمم على ذلك.‬‬ S1 , E152 : A young woman faces constant torment and oppression from her family, but remains resilient in her search for love and happiness.

programme.title: ديفي ماتاميام - Devi Mahathmyam
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح727 : ‫مختارات من القصص التي تتناول الأساطير والخرافات المتعلقة بالإلهة دورجا، إلى جانب حكايات أشكالها ومظاهرها المختلفة.‬‬ S1 , E727 : An anthology of stories which deal with the legends and myths related to Goddess Durga, along with the tales of her various forms and manifestations.

programme.title: سانثوانام - Santhwanam
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح72 : ‫تعيش سريديفي حياة هانئة وسعيدة مع زوجها بالاكريشنان وأشقائه، لكن تواجه العائلة العديد من المصاعب التي تحد من علاقتها الوثيقة.‬‬ S1 , E72 : Sridevi leads a peaceful and happy life with her husband, Balakrishnan, and his siblings. However, the family faces various adversities that challenge their bonding.

programme.title: موناراغم - Mounaragam
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح1603 : ‫تعاني كالياني من ضعف في النطق وجميع أفراد عائلتها يكرهونها باستثناء والدتها. وبينما تتوق إلى حنان والدها، يدخل كيران حياتها.‬‬ S1 , E1603 : Kalyani, who is speech impaired, is disliked by everyone in her family, except her mother. As she longs for her father's affection, Kiran enters her life.

programme.title: غيثا غوفيندام - Geetha Govindam
programme.desc: ‫م1 ، ح64 : ‫يواجه رجل أعمال في منتصف العمر أعزب ماضيه الغامض، مما يؤثر على علاقته الرومانسية الاستثنائية بشابة تصغره في السن.‬‬ S1 , E64 : When the past of a middle-aged unmarried businessman confronts him, it affects his unusual romantic relationship with a younger girl.

programme.title: سانثوانام - Santhwanam

programme.title: موناراغم - Mounaragam

programme.desc: Join Tianran He on a high-speed train to Shigatse, gateway to the Himalayas and home to Mount Qomolangma, the world’s highest peak. He then visits an agricultural park where tropical crops thrive against the odds of the alpine plateau, before discovering pulu — a traditional Tibetan textile now earning global acclaim.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He travels to Shannan, the cradle of Tibetan culture. Nestled in the gentlest valley of the Yarlung Zangbo River, this is where the first Tibetan king rose to power, the first palace in Xizang was built, and many other “firsts” in Xizang’s history began. Tianran visits Yamdrok Lake, one of Xizang’s three sacred lakes, where a paragliding base is taking shape. He then learns the art of Tibetan opera, joins rangers on a mission to track the elusive Tibetan red deer, and ends the day with a rejuvenating soak in a village revitalized by hot spring tourism.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.5

programme.title: Seafaring Tales: Fu Ships
programme.desc: In past centuries, transporting goods along the Maritime Silk Road could be a hazardous undertaking. Ships often faced fierce storms which blew up on the high seas. To reduce the danger, China’s shipbuilders came up with a solution. They developed Fu ships, commonly known as junks, incorporating a special watertight bulkhead technology. Their revolutionary design allowed the ships to withstand the highest winds and roughest waters. The Maritime Silk Road was an ancient trading route that connected China to Southeast and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. As a key passageway for trade and cultural exchange, it thrived for well over a thousand years, bringing Chinese tea, silk, porcelain, spices, and other precious cargo to the rest of the planet. The legacy of the Maritime Silk Road is still evident today in many parts of the world.

programme.title: Yangliuqing New Year Painting Art
programme.desc: On May 20, 2006, Yangliuqing New Year Paintings were named as part of China’s national intangible cultural heritage. The New Year painting tradition can be traced back many centuries, to the Ming Dynasty and beyond, reaching the height of its popularity in the Qing Dynasty. There are no restrictions on the themes of the paintings, and there is no blessing they cannot convey. Yangliuqing New Year Paintings are loved all over the country for their beautiful details and vivid colors—but most of all, for the good wishes they impart to anyone who sees them.

programme.title: Seafaring Tales: Fu Ships
programme.desc: In past centuries, transporting goods along the Maritime Silk Road could be a hazardous undertaking. Ships often faced fierce storms which blew up on the high seas. To reduce the danger, China’s shipbuilders came up with a solution. They developed Fu ships, commonly known as junks, incorporating a special watertight bulkhead technology. Their revolutionary design allowed the ships to withstand the highest winds and roughest waters. The Maritime Silk Road was an ancient trading route that connected China to Southeast and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. As a key passageway for trade and cultural exchange, it thrived for well over a thousand years, bringing Chinese tea, silk, porcelain, spices, and other precious cargo to the rest of the planet. The legacy of the Maritime Silk Road is still evident today in many parts of the world.

programme.title: Yangliuqing New Year Painting Art
programme.desc: On May 20, 2006, Yangliuqing New Year Paintings were named as part of China’s national intangible cultural heritage. The New Year painting tradition can be traced back many centuries, to the Ming Dynasty and beyond, reaching the height of its popularity in the Qing Dynasty. There are no restrictions on the themes of the paintings, and there is no blessing they cannot convey. Yangliuqing New Year Paintings are loved all over the country for their beautiful details and vivid colors—but most of all, for the good wishes they impart to anyone who sees them.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.

programme.title: China Bound: Chengdu

Of course, no visit to this city is complete without seeing giant pandas and enjoying a cup of tea while getting your ears cleaned in the iconic People's Park. After all, when in Chengdu, do as the locals do.

programme.title: Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and the EU, Inheritors of China launches a special multimedia series titled “Dream Builders: Stories from China and Europe.” Taking culture as the starting point, the series responds to public discourse by telling the real-life stories of Europeans living in China. Through their perspectives, it vividly illustrates how tradition and modernity spark mutual inspiration between China and Europe—showcasing a relationship of shared growth, empowerment, and enduring partnership. The series travels through cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Jinan, and Datong, focusing on Europeans of different ages and professions—from programming and installation art to music, calligraphy, and martial arts. Their lived experiences offer fresh insight into how cultural exchange between China and Europe continues to gain vitality, and how mutual learning between civilizations breathes lasting life into practical cooperation.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.

programme.title: China Bound: Chengdu
programme.desc: Tianran spends 3 days in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province and UNESCO's first City of Gastronomy. He dives deep into Chengdu culture, exploring the infamous "mala" numbing and spicy flavors of Sichuanese street food and hotpot, and visiting historical attractions like Wuhou Shrine, Du Fu's Thatched Cottage, and the Jinsha Site Museum, which houses exquisite relics from a 3,000-year-old kingdom uncovered beneath the streets of Chengdu. Of course, no visit to this city is complete without seeing giant pandas and enjoying a cup of tea while getting your ears cleaned in the iconic People's Park. After all, when in Chengdu, do as the locals do.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: Mount Wutai, Embracing the Wonders of Nature
programme.desc: Mount Wutai, in the northeastern part of Shanxi Province, is one of the Four Great Buddhist Mountains of China. It is a magnet for tourists, who are drawn here not only by its profound Buddhist cultural heritage, but also by the spectacular natural scenery. Mount Wutai is noted for its unique topography, marked by five flattened peaks. Hence the name "Wutai," or “Five Terraces.” The five, each with its own characteristics and distinct shape, are Wanghai East Peak, Guayue West Peak, Jinxiu South Peak, Yedou North Peak, and Cuiyan Central Peak. Soaring into the clouds, together they resemble a magnificent work crafted by nature.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: Mount Wutai, Embracing the Wonders of Nature
programme.desc: Mount Wutai, in the northeastern part of Shanxi Province, is one of the Four Great Buddhist Mountains of China. It is a magnet for tourists, who are drawn here not only by its profound Buddhist cultural heritage, but also by the spectacular natural scenery. Mount Wutai is noted for its unique topography, marked by five flattened peaks. Hence the name "Wutai," or “Five Terraces.” The five, each with its own characteristics and distinct shape, are Wanghai East Peak, Guayue West Peak, Jinxiu South Peak, Yedou North Peak, and Cuiyan Central Peak. Soaring into the clouds, together they resemble a magnificent work crafted by nature.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: Mount Wutai, Embracing the Wonders of Nature
programme.desc: Mount Wutai, in the northeastern part of Shanxi Province, is one of the Four Great Buddhist Mountains of China. It is a magnet for tourists, who are drawn here not only by its profound Buddhist cultural heritage, but also by the spectacular natural scenery. Mount Wutai is noted for its unique topography, marked by five flattened peaks. Hence the name "Wutai," or “Five Terraces.” The five, each with its own characteristics and distinct shape, are Wanghai East Peak, Guayue West Peak, Jinxiu South Peak, Yedou North Peak, and Cuiyan Central Peak. Soaring into the clouds, together they resemble a magnificent work crafted by nature.

programme.title: Ningxia: Echoes of the Yellow River
programme.desc: Ningxia: Echoes of the Yellow River is a documentary focusing on the World Heritage sites and cultural–ecological conservation in the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region. Through the lens of Ningxia’s heritage stories, the film highlights China’s commitment to World Heritage preservation, ecological restoration, and cultural continuity — presenting to global audiences a land where history and modernity intertwine, and where desert and oasis coexist. By following the guardians of the Western Xia Imperial Tombs, desert restorers in the Tengger Desert, Great Wall rangers at Sanguankou, traditional sheepskin raft craftsmen, and managers of the Yellow River irrigation system in Qingtongxia, the program reveals Ningxia’s distinctive contributions to cultural heritage, natural ecology, and intangible traditions — and the enduring human spirit behind them.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Miao Embroidery: History in Stitches
programme.desc: According to legend, during a migration by the Miao ethnic group, a female chieftain wanted to keep a record of all the mountains and lakes she passed along the way. The means she chose of doing so was by stitching the images on her dress. By the time they reached a suitable place to settle, her clothing was covered with embroidered designs. This, it’s said, was the origin of Miao embroidery. As the story tells us, the designs in Miao embroidery are closely related to the natural world and daily life. The Miao people have a special fondness for nature. So, as well as depicting their daily farming and work activities, they copy birds, flowers, mountains, and grass onto their clothing. Over the years, the embroidery of the Miao people has become a written record of their life. The stitches are like characters which, when many of them are combined, become a record of their history, their collected wisdom, and the knowledge passed down from their ancestors.

programme.title: Ningxia: Echoes of the Yellow River
programme.desc: Ningxia: Echoes of the Yellow River is a documentary focusing on the World Heritage sites and cultural–ecological conservation in the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region. Through the lens of Ningxia’s heritage stories, the film highlights China’s commitment to World Heritage preservation, ecological restoration, and cultural continuity — presenting to global audiences a land where history and modernity intertwine, and where desert and oasis coexist. By following the guardians of the Western Xia Imperial Tombs, desert restorers in the Tengger Desert, Great Wall rangers at Sanguankou, traditional sheepskin raft craftsmen, and managers of the Yellow River irrigation system in Qingtongxia, the program reveals Ningxia’s distinctive contributions to cultural heritage, natural ecology, and intangible traditions — and the enduring human spirit behind them.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Miao Embroidery: History in Stitches
programme.desc: According to legend, during a migration by the Miao ethnic group, a female chieftain wanted to keep a record of all the mountains and lakes she passed along the way. The means she chose of doing so was by stitching the images on her dress. By the time they reached a suitable place to settle, her clothing was covered with embroidered designs. This, it’s said, was the origin of Miao embroidery. As the story tells us, the designs in Miao embroidery are closely related to the natural world and daily life. The Miao people have a special fondness for nature. So, as well as depicting their daily farming and work activities, they copy birds, flowers, mountains, and grass onto their clothing. Over the years, the embroidery of the Miao people has become a written record of their life. The stitches are like characters which, when many of them are combined, become a record of their history, their collected wisdom, and the knowledge passed down from their ancestors.

programme.title: Ningxia: Echoes of the Yellow River
programme.desc: Ningxia: Echoes of the Yellow River is a documentary focusing on the World Heritage sites and cultural–ecological conservation in the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region. Through the lens of Ningxia’s heritage stories, the film highlights China’s commitment to World Heritage preservation, ecological restoration, and cultural continuity — presenting to global audiences a land where history and modernity intertwine, and where desert and oasis coexist. By following the guardians of the Western Xia Imperial Tombs, desert restorers in the Tengger Desert, Great Wall rangers at Sanguankou, traditional sheepskin raft craftsmen, and managers of the Yellow River irrigation system in Qingtongxia, the program reveals Ningxia’s distinctive contributions to cultural heritage, natural ecology, and intangible traditions — and the enduring human spirit behind them.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Miao Embroidery: History in Stitches
programme.desc: According to legend, during a migration by the Miao ethnic group, a female chieftain wanted to keep a record of all the mountains and lakes she passed along the way. The means she chose of doing so was by stitching the images on her dress. By the time they reached a suitable place to settle, her clothing was covered with embroidered designs. This, it’s said, was the origin of Miao embroidery. As the story tells us, the designs in Miao embroidery are closely related to the natural world and daily life. The Miao people have a special fondness for nature. So, as well as depicting their daily farming and work activities, they copy birds, flowers, mountains, and grass onto their clothing. Over the years, the embroidery of the Miao people has become a written record of their life. The stitches are like characters which, when many of them are combined, become a record of their history, their collected wisdom, and the knowledge passed down from their ancestors.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: The Story of Flying Trident
programme.desc: Feicha, or a flying trident, is a type of performance where you balance a revolving trident on your body. In Chinese history, the trident was one of the 18 main weapons of war, but now it has become more of an acrobatic act. For thousands of years, people in China have practiced it as a performance and also as a way to keep fit. It seems like the trident is stuck to the person’s body like a magnet, but that effect is achieved by tensing and relaxing muscles at the right time so that the movement of the trident is channeled in the right direction—be it around the hands, neck, or back. Otherwise, its energy will turn against the performer.

programme.title: World Heritages in Handan
programme.desc: Handan, a renowned historical and cultural city in China, boasts abundant cultural and tourism resources, including the Handan Museum and Congtai Park in Congtai District, as well as the Xiangtangshan Grottoes, Guangfu Ancient City, Cizhou Kiln, etc. Handan also has a long-standing connection with the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, a world cultural heritage. programme.title: World Heritages in China: A Journey on Water from Wuxi to Yixing

programme.title: Miao Silverware: A Shining Epic
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the fascinating world of the silver-working art of the Miao ethnic group. Join us, and hear the stories and see the works of four remarkable individuals. From a national-level inheritor who is preserving the traditional craft, to an artist infusing personal flair into his designs; from a female silversmith imbuing her work with feminine warmth, to a young artisan inspiring a new generation, we investigate the rich heritage, cultural significance, and evolving potential of Miao silverware.

programme.desc: يعيش الشبل المراهق ليث مغامرات مليئة بالمتعة والتشويق، يتخللها مواقف مضحكة وممتعة بآن معاً. لا تفوتوا متابعة تفاصيل حياته وأفراد عائلته، في هذا المسلسل الكرتوني الرائع. programme.desc: نظرة متفحصة ومقابلات مع المطّلعين على ما يشبه المعجزات الهندسية والعلمية التي تقف وراء أشياء، تشكّل العالم الحديث، بما فيه من إبهار وروعة. An insider's look and interviews show the engineering and scientific miracles behind the things that form the modern world.

programme.title: وييلر دييلرز:بي إم دبليو إيسيتا - Wheeler Dealers:BMW Isetta
programme.desc: تاجر السيارات المخضرم (مايك بروير) والميكانيكي متعدد المواهب (آنت آنستيد) يبحثان عن السيارات المميزة الأيقونية والقديمة لبيعها من أجل الربح. في كل حلقة، ينطلق (مايك) للعثور على محرك يتمتع بإمكانية جني الأموال، بحيث يمكنه تسليم السيارة إلى (آنت) ليبدأ بالعمل عليها لتستعيد مجدها السابق. Experienced car dealer Mike Brewer and multi-talented mechanic, Ant Anstead are tasked with finding and restoring faded iconic cars to sell for a profit. In each episode, Mike sets out to find a motor with money-making potential that he can hand over to Ant to restore back to its former glory.

programme.title: ميستري أوف بلايند فروغّ رانتش:آزتيك أور نَت؟ - Mystery Of Blind Frog Ranch:Aztec Or Not?
programme.desc: يعتقد السكان المحليون في ولاية (يوتا) أن مزرعة (بلايند فروغّ رانتش) ملعونة وفيها كنوز مخفية. يقوم مالك الأرض (دوين أولينار) الآن بمهمة للعثور على ما هو مخفي في الكهوف السبعة الموجودة تحت الأرض، في مزرعة تبلغ مساحتها 160 فداناً. Locals in Utah believe that the Blind Frog Ranch is cursed and has hidden treasures. The landowner Duane Ollinger is now on a mission to find what is hidden in the seven underground caves on the 160-acre ranch.

programme.title: أخطر الطرائد المائية:40-فوت مونسترز - Deadliest Catch:40-Foot Monsters
programme.desc: هذه السلسلة من أكثر الوظائف دموية على وجه الأرض: صيد سرطان البحر قبالة ساحل ألاسكا على بحر بيرينغ الجليدي. يخاطر هؤلاء المغامرون بحياتهم وهم يقاتلون طقس القطب الشمالي والأمواج الوحشية والسباق عكس عقارب الساعة، ليحصدوا الأموال الطائلة، في اندفاع نحو ذهب-العصر الحديث. programme.desc: مسلسل ريادي جرى فيه تأريخ التحقيقات في جرائم القتل من خلال لقطات درامية من واقع الحياة. يتابع مشاهدوه عن قرب كل قضية باستخدام لقطات خام كما هي غير منقحة، من كاميرات مثبتة على الملابس من مسرح الجريمة، وكاميرات المراقبة وغرف الاستجواب. Homicide investigations are chronicled with dramatic real-life footage in this groundbreaking series. Viewers get an up-close perspective of each case using raw, unfiltered footage from body cams at the crime scene, surveillance cameras and interrogation rooms.

programme.desc: يتابع هذا الفيلم الوثائقي قضية عائلة ماكستاي المفقودة بعد العثور على رفاتها في النهاية وبعد مرور 3 سنوات، في قبر ضحل؛ ومحاكمة تشارلز ميريت اللاحقة، بصفته المشتبه به الرئيسي. This documentary follows the case of a missing McStay family whose remains were eventually found 3 years later in a shallow grave and the consequent trial Charles Merritt, the prime suspect.

programme.title: ميراكيلس وورلد: طوكيو، ستيلر فورس - Miraculous World: Tokyo, Stellar Force
programme.desc: عندما تسافر ليدي باغ إلى طوكيو، تلتقي بميكي وكازونو، وهما عضوان في فريق (القوة النجمية)، الفريق الياباني للأبطال الخارقين. وبالتعاون معاً، يتحدون لإيقاف شرير خارق جديد يحاول نشر الفوضى في المدينة. When Ladybug travels to Tokyo, she meets Miki and Kazuno, members of the Stellar Force, a Japanese superhero team. Together, they join forces to stop a new supervillain from wreaking havoc in the city.

programme.title: ميراكيوليس: تشيبي - Miraculous: Chibi
programme.desc: عندما لا يكون الأبطال في مهمة، يحاول كات نوير باستمرار التقرب من ليدي باج. لكنه لا يعلم أنها مهتمة فقط بأدريان، الشخصية الحقيقية لكات نوير. When the heroes aren’t on a mission, Cat Noir always tries to be nice to Ladybug. But he doesn’t know that Ladybug only cares about Adrien, Cat Noir’s real identity.

Tween vampire Vee joins boarding school to chase her musical dreams but keeps her vampire identity a secret. Meanwhile, her overprotective father assigns a ghostly guardian to watch over her.

programme.desc:
الحب من أول "بايت"/ دورة جيدة واحدة
حينما تصبح الأم مشغولة بإقامة حفل، فتطلب المساعدة من "فارس" و"فادي" لجعل الحفلة لا تُنسى. في هذه الأثناء، "سندس" تحاول النيل من أخويها، لكن انضمامها إلى أمهما يقعد الأمر. هناك في الحفل، "أبو الأشرار" يحاول جعل "نورم" يتعرف على روبوت نسائي، لكن "نورم" يفقد صوابه. / بعد أن شاهدت فيلمًا مُلهمًا تقوم ببطولته فتاة قوية، "سندس" و"زهرة" تتحديان ضد مجموعات في دورة "فارس" و"فادي" للعقبات. في الجهة الأخرى من البلدة، "أبو الأشرار" يخطط لإذلال أخيه، العمدة، باستخدام جهازه الجديد والذي يهين عمدة "ستامبلغيمب" ويجبره على رقصة "الندم" المخجلة. programme.desc:
"دووفابوس" / أطلق العنان لـ"نورم"
تتحول "سندس" إلى سائل بسبب جهاز "فارس" و"فادي. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يحول نفسه إلى خلد الماء لهزيمة "بيري"، لكنه يجد الأمر أصعب مما كان يتخيل. / "سندس" تجد الأمر صعبًا للنيل من الأخوين حينما يبنيان "نانوبوت" والتي بإمكانها التشكل على أي شيء. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" لديه استدعاء لهيئة المحلفين لذلك "نورم" يتولى أمر خطة اليوم الشريرة. Doofapus/ Norm Unleashed
Change is afoot when Candace accidentally liquefies herself by coming in contact with Phineas and Ferb's device that turns solids into liquids. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz turns himself into a platypus to defeat Perry in battle, but finds it's harder than he ever imagined./ Candace finds it difficult to bust Phineas and Ferb when her brothers build nanobots that can assemble into any object they can imagine. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz has jury duty, so Norm takes over the day's evil scheme.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
حينما تصطدم العوالم / الطريق إلى "دانفيل"
بعد اكتشاف كوكب متجه نحو "دانفيل"، "فارس" و"فادي" يحاولان تفادي المصيبة، في هذا الحين، فؤاد يتطلع إلى الاتصال بالفضائيين. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يأمل بأن يسرق أكبر كرة خيوط في العالم. / حينما يُصعق "أبو الأشرار" من أحد أجهزته والعميل السري في مكان بعيد، فيجب عليهما أن يخوضا مغامرة كبيرة وصعبة للعودة إلى الديار. When Worlds Collide/ Road to Danville
After discovering that a strange planet is hurtling directly towards Danville, Phineas and Ferb set out to avert a disaster, while Buford looks forward to making contact with its alien race. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshirmtz hopes to steal the world's largest ball of twine./ When one of Dr. Doofenshmirtz's "-inators" zaps him and Agent P into the middle of nowhere, they must embark on a comical journey filled with twists and turns to return home.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
أين "بيري"؟
العائلة تذهب في رحلة إلى إفريقيا، لكن حينما يتلقى "بيري" اتصالًا من "اللواء منير"، يجب أن يتغلب على المرض لإنقاذ اليوم. في هذه الأثناء، يخطط "أبو الأشرار" لإلهاء العميل السري والجهاز المزيف لكي يستخدم جهاز الشر النهائي تجاه "اللواء منير" والسيطرة على منظمة "بلا برودة". رغم ذلك" بعد أن صُعق "كارل" على نحو خطأ، خطة "أبو الأشرار" تأخذ مجرى آخر حينما العميل السري يختفي بعد أن صُعق بشعاع. Where's Perry? (Part I) (Part 1 of 2)
The family embarks on a trip to Africa, but when Perry receives an urgent call from Major Monogram, he has to feign illness in order to save the day. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz plans to distract Agent P with a phony "inator," so that he can use his "Ultimate Evil-inator" ray on Major Monogram and take over OWCA. However, after Carl is inadvertently hit, Dr. Doofenshmirtz's plan takes an unexpected turn, and Agent P disappears after being struck by one of the rays.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
شكرًا لكن لا شكر / قصة "تروي"
بعد أن علم "كارل" بعلاقة "فانيسا" و"مونتي"، "كارل" يرشي "مونتي" لكي يساعده في الحصول على معلومات متعلقة بـ"اللواء منير". في هذه الأثناء، "سندس" تشعر بالسعادة حينما تكتشف أن جارتها "بيغي مكغي" قد شاهدت تحف "فارس" و"فادي" الصيفية وتسعد بأنها ستخبر الأم بالأمر. / مستوحى من كتب "سندس"، من كتاب "الإلياذة"، الولدان يعيدان تمثيل حصان طروادة لكن على طريقتهما. في هذه الأثناء، "بيري" يكتشف أن "أبو الأشرار" لديه مشكلة كبيرة متعلقة بالاستغناء عن الأشياء فيساعده لصنع جهاز الترتيب. Thanks but No Thanks/ Troy Story
After learning about Monty and Vanessa’s secret relationship, Carl bribes Monty into helping him get some much needed acknowledgement from Monogram. Meanwhile, Candace is ecstatic when she discovers that her neighbor Peggy McGee has witnessed all of Phineas and Ferb’s summer antics and is happy to tell Mom about them. / Inspired by Candace’s book club selection, “The Illiad,” the boys reenact the Trojan War—but with a Phineas and Ferb twist. Meanwhile, Perry discovers that Doofenshmirtz has a major problem with throwing things away so he helps him find his De-Clutter-Inator.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
الحب من أول "بايت"/ دورة جيدة واحدة
حينما تصبح الأم مشغولة بإقامة حفل، فتطلب المساعدة من "فارس" و"فادي" لجعل الحفلة لا تُنسى. في هذه الأثناء، "سندس" تحاول النيل من أخويها، لكن انضمامها إلى أمهما يقعد الأمر. هناك في الحفل، "أبو الأشرار" يحاول جعل "نورم" يتعرف على روبوت نسائي، لكن "نورم" يفقد صوابه. / بعد أن شاهدت فيلمًا مُلهمًا تقوم ببطولته فتاة قوية، "سندس" و"زهرة" تتحديان ضد مجموعات في دورة "فارس" و"فادي" للعقبات. في الجهة الأخرى من البلدة، "أبو الأشرار" يخطط لإذلال أخيه، العمدة، باستخدام جهازه الجديد والذي يهين عمدة "ستامبلغيمب" ويجبره على رقصة "الندم" المخجلة. Love at First Byte/ One Good Turn
When Mom becomes overwhelmed with organizing a block party, she asks Phineas and Ferb for their help in making the party’s finale memorable. Meanwhile, Candace plans to bust her brothers, but their team up with Mom throws a bit of a wrench into her situation. Over at the block party, Doofenshmirtz tries to set Norm up with a female robot, but Norm’s nerves get the best of him./ Motivated by a movie with a strong heroine, Candace and Stacy feel empowered to team up against rival groups and compete in Phineas and Ferb’s Ultimate Obstacle Course. Across town, Doofenshmirtz plans to humiliate his brother, the Mayor, by using his 90 Degree-turn-inator on him so that he will accidentally insult the Mayor of Stumblegimp (voiced by Billy Gardell) and be forced to perform the shameful "Dance of Contrition" to make amends.

programme.title: فينيس وفيرب - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
"جميلة" معبد "ساب"
يحصل "بخيت" على استراحة من دراسته المكثفة للتجول في المدينة داخل فقاعة عملاقة مع "فارس" و"فادي". حين تراهما "سندس" أثناء حضور درس في القيادة مع والدتها، فتلحق بهما لضبطهما. وفي الوقت نفسه، يتآمر الدكتور "أبو الأشرار" على تنويم "منطقة الولاية الثلاثية" مغناطيسيًا من خلال دندنة نغمة بلد غربي بجهاز يمنحه صوتًا رائعًا. / تذهب "جميلة" و"أديسون" وباقي فتيات المدفأة في مغامرة للحصول على وشاح من أجل جمع العصارة. في مغامرتهم، يلتقون بكاهن ويستعينون به لمساعدتهم في تأمين المكون الأخير للحصول على الوشاح. في هذه الأثناء، يولي الأدميرال كلب "جميلة"، بينكي، المعروف أيضًا باسم العميل "بينكي"، مهمة إحباط الأفعال الشريرة التي يقوم بها الأستاذ "بوفينبلوتز" Isabella and the Temple of SAP

في عالمٍ حيث تتداخل الأسرار مع المشاعر، يقترب "مارينت" و"أدريان" من بعضهما أكثر من أي وقتٍ مضى. ومع ذلك، لا يزال كلٌ منهما يخفي عن الآخر هويته البطولية. لكن "مارينت" تحمل سرًا أشد وطأة؛ فهي تعلم أن والد "أدريان" لم يكن سوى شرير خارق سابق! وفي الوقت نفسه، تجد الدعسوقة والقط الأسود نفسيهما في مواجهة عدو غامض ومراوغ، يسعى بكل دهاء لسرقة "الميراكيلوس" وإغراق باريس في دوامة من الفوضى. وبينما تنطلق المغامرات، يقف أبطالنا جنبًا إلى جنب مع زملائهم في المدرسة وفريق من الأبطال الخارقين الجدد، ليواجهوا عامًا دراسيًا عاصفًا، مليئًا بالمفاجآت والمشاعر الجارفة وكشف الأسرار التي ستغير كل شيء. "كيف" مصرة على دخول ردهة الكلية، ولكن هل ستتمكن من الخروج منها؟ تحاول "كيف" أن تفشل في وظيفتها كمساعدة شخصية لـ"هيلين"، لتخضع من جديد للاختبار الوظيفي. Faculty Lounge/ Personal Assistant
Kiff is determined to get inside of the faculty lounge, but once there, can she get out? Kiff tries to fail at being Helen's personal assistant so she can retake her career test.

يتابع المسلسل كيف، أنثى سنجاب متفائلة، يقودها تعطشها للحياة إلى عيش مغامرات عديدة في بلدتها، إلى جانب باري، صديقها المفضل الرائع. تدور الأحداث في بلدة تتعايش فيها الحيوانات والمخلوقات السحرية، ويتخطى الثنائي المدرسة والعلاقات ومجتمعها الذي غالباً ما يتسم بالغرابة. Weekly Grocery Shop
The Chatterleys each encounter an obstacle during their weekly grocery shopping trip.

يكتشف "بيل" أن ممثله الهزلي المفضل الفلاح "فريد" قد لا يكون كما يدّعي. وتدافع "تيلي" عن "كريكت" في محاكمة عائلية بعد اتهامه بسرقة كعكة كاملة. Stand-Up Bill/ Green Trial
Bill discovers his favorite comedian, Fred the Farmer, may not be who he claims to be. Tilly defends Cricket at a family trial after he's accused of stealing an entire cake.

Cricket and Tilly get to know their grandpa while Nancy scrambles to find him a job. Desperate to ensure his family’s future security, Bill becomes a hoarder.

بدلة "سندس" التي صنعها "بيوفورد" تدب فيها الحياة وتحاول الاستيلاء على حياة سندس الحقيقية، وتتجاهل سندس أخويها ليوم كامل من أجل مساعدة والدتها في مهمة خاصة بها. Attack of the Candace Suit/ Book Flub
Buford's Candace suit comes to life and tries to take over the real Candace's life; Candace ignores her brothers for a day in order to help her Mom with a bust of her own.

تسافر "فانيسا" و"أبو الأشرار" إلى "دروسلشتاين" بينما يحفر الأولاد للعثور على خاتم زفاف والدتهم المفقود، يبني الأطفال قصراً للطيور من أجل ببغاء مكاو نادر، بينما يواجه "أبو الأشرار" حشرات فرس النبي العملاقة. Bad Old Days, The/ Mantis Fact!
Vanessa and Doof travel to Drusselstein while the boys dig for Mom's lost wedding ring; The kids build a bird mansion for a rare macaw while Doof deals with giant praying mantises.

programme.title: عالم الميراكولاس: "شنغهاي"، أسطورة "ليدي دراجون" - Miraculous World: Shanghai, The Legend of Ladydragon
programme.desc:
عالم الميراكولاس: "شنغهاي"، أسطورة "ليدي دراجون"
"مارينيت" في إجازة مدرسية وكل الأمور تسير على ما يرام. حتى يصلها خبر أن "أدريان" ذاهب إلى "شنغهاي"، "الصين"، مع والده. لحسن الحظ، يعيش عمها "وانج" هناك، وقد اقترب عيد ميلاده! لذا، لمقابلة "آدريان" والتعرف على أصول أسرتها، قررت "مارينيت" أن تأخذ هدية العم "وانج" إليه بنفسها. ولكن بعد وقت قصير من وصولها، فقدت "مارينيت" كل أغراضها، بما في ذلك حقيبتها، و"تيكي" والميراكولاس اللذان يتيحان لها التحول إلى الدعسوقة Miraculous World: Shanghai, The Legend of Ladydragon
Marinette is on a school break and everything is fine…until she learns that Adrien had to go to Shanghai, China, with his father. Luckily, her Uncle Wang lives there, and his birthday is coming up soon! To go meet Adrien and her own origins, Marinette decides to take his gift to Uncle Wang herself. But soon after arriving, Marinette loses all her stuff, including her purse, Tikki…and the Miraculous that allows her to turn into Ladybug!

When an oracle from the wizard world shows up on Billie's doorstep and predicts that Billie will destroy the big summer carnival, Billie stops at nothing to change the future.

programme.title: ميراكيلوس: الدعسوقة والقط الأسود - Miraculous Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir: Season 6
programme.desc:
ميراكيلوس: الدعسوقة والقط الأسود
في عالمٍ حيث تتداخل الأسرار مع المشاعر، يقترب "مارينت" و"أدريان" من بعضهما أكثر من أي وقتٍ مضى. ومع ذلك، لا يزال كلٌ منهما يخفي عن الآخر هويته البطولية. لكن "مارينت" تحمل سرًا أشد وطأة؛ فهي تعلم أن والد "أدريان" لم يكن سوى شرير خارق سابق! وفي الوقت نفسه، تجد الدعسوقة والقط الأسود نفسيهما في مواجهة عدو غامض ومراوغ، يسعى بكل دهاء لسرقة "الميراكيلوس" وإغراق باريس في دوامة من الفوضى. وبينما تنطلق المغامرات، يقف أبطالنا جنبًا إلى جنب مع زملائهم في المدرسة وفريق من الأبطال الخارقين الجدد، ليواجهوا عامًا دراسيًا عاصفًا، مليئًا بالمفاجآت والمشاعر الجارفة وكشف الأسرار التي ستغير كل شيء. The Illustrhater
Marinette has everything to be on cloud nine: she is finally going out with Adrien, and she has a team of superheroes to support her as Ladybug! Except this is all a leap into the unknown. And if there is one thing that Marinette struggles to do, it is not being in control.

programme.title: مدينة الجرينز الكبيرة - Big City Greens
programme.desc:
شجرة العائلة / بلا حراسة
يريد "بيل" أن تنزل "تيلي" من على الشجرة، وعندما يخبر "ريمي" "فاسكويز" أنه لم يعد بحاجة إلى حمايته، يتحدث "فاسكويز" إلى معالج نفسي. Family Tree/ Unguarded
Bill just wants Tilly to come down from a tree. When Remy tells Vasquez he no longer needs his protection, Vasquez speaks with a therapist.

A nature documentary portrays Big City as a wild ecosystem. Avid collector Remy struggles to cope after Cricket finds the rarest of all trading cards.

Reggie is the first kid in Table Town to mow his own lawn and Kiff wants to be the second; When Harry runs away, Barry and Kiff do anything they can to bring him back.

A trip to Table Town Museum is threatened when Kiff and Barry get into silly moods. When leftovers go missing in the Chatterley home, they must settle the matter in family court.

programme.title: فينيس وفيرب - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
هجوم الأخت البالغة 50 قدمًا/ ألعاب مائية في الفناء الخلفي
عند دخول "بخيت" في مسابقة زراعة الخضروات في المعرض المحلي، ابتكر "فارس" و"فادي" لتسريع عملية النمو. في هذه الأثناء، تحاول "سندس" أن تشق طريقها في مجال عرض الأزياء، لكن قيل لها إنها قصيرة جدًا. استخدم "فارس" و"فادي" أحدث اختراعاتهما لمساعدتها على النمو، لكنها لا تتوقف عن النمو. / يشيد "فارس" و"فادي" حوضًا مائيًا في الفناء الخلفي لمنزلهما، وبينما تنتظر "سندس" بفارغ الصبر مكالمة هاتفية من "جيرمي"، انجرفت إلى عرض الدلافين. في هذه الأثناء، يتخلص الدكتور "أبو الأشرار" من جميع كرات الشاطئ في "منطقة الولاية الثلاثية" نظرًا لأنها تذكره دومًا بحادث كرة الشاطئ المأساوي من الجامعة. Attack of the 50 Foot Sister/ Backyard Aquarium
When Baljeet enters a vegetable growing contest at the local fair, Phineas and Ferb create the PhineasandFerbalizer to speed up the growing process. Meanwhile, Candace is attempting to make her way in the modeling business, but is told she's too short. Phineas and Ferb use their newest invention to help her grow, but she doesn't stop growing./ Phineas and Ferb build an aquarium in their backyard, and while Candace eagerly awaits a phone call from Jeremy, she is swept into the dolphin show. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz is getting rid of all the beach balls in the tri-state area as they are a constant reminder of a tragic beach ball incident from college.

programme.title: فينيس وفيرب - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
يوم حلوى الجلاتين/ بديهي يا عزيزتي "زهرة"
يملأ "فارس" و"فادي" حمام سباحة "جميلة" بحلوى الجيلاتين النطاطية، وتدب الحياة بها عندما يتم إطلاق آلة الشر الخاصة بالدكتور "أبو الأشرار" عن طريق الخطأ. بينما يستمتع الأطفال بمحاربة الجيلاتين، فإن "سندس" عالقة تطفو بعد أن يبتلعها المخلوق بالكامل. / تقوم العائلة برحلة أخرى إلى إنكلترا لزيارة الأجداد وجلب صديقة "سندس"، "زهرة" (كيلي هو، "X2"). حين ينشغل "فارس" و"فادي" في أمر غامض، تستخدم `"سندس" وزهرة" مهاراتهما الجديدة في التجسس لمعرفة ما الذي يخططان له. في هذه الأثناء، يتحد "بيري" مع نظيره البريطاني، العميل المزدوج O-O (داميان لويس ، "الحياة") لمنع الدكتور "أبو الأشرار" من سرقة ساعة "بيغ بن". Day of the Living Gelatin/ Elementary, My Dear Stacy
Phineas and Ferb fill Isabella's swimming pool with bouncy gelatin, and it comes to life when Dr. Doofenshmirtz's "Evil-inator" machine is accidentally unleashed. While the kids have a blast battling the gelatin, Candace is stuck floating in it after the creature swallows her whole./ The family takes another trip to England to visit the grandparents and bring Candace's friend, Stacy (Kelly Hu, "X2"). When Phineas and Ferb get caught up in something mysterious, Candace and Stacy use their newfound sleuthing skills to figure out what they are up to. Meanwhile, Perry is teamed with his British counterpart, Agent Double O-O (Damian Lewis, "Life") to stop Dr. Doofenshmirtz from stealing Big Ben.

programme.title: فينيس وفيرب - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
إياك أن ترمش/ مطعم "شي بلاتيبوس"
تصمم "سندس "أكثر من أي وقت مضى على كشف تصرفات أخويها الغريبة، لذلك قررت معرفة مكان اختفاء إبداعاتهم البرية. حتى إن "فارس" و"فادي" يشعران بالفضول، لذا بمساعدة أصدقائهما في الحي، يحاولون مساعدة "سندس" في حل اللغز. ومع ذلك، فإن آلة الأشعة الخفية الخاصة بالدكتور "أبو الأشرار" تضع عقبة أمام سعي "سندس" لضبط أخويها. / فتح "فارس" و"فادي" "تشز خلد الماء"، مطعم أنيق على طراز خلد الماء والذي أصبح المطعم الأكثر عصرية في المدينة. يطلب "جيرمي" من "سندس" أخيرًا الخروج في موعد على العشاء في "تشز خلد الماء"، وعلى الرغم من حقيقة أن المطعم في فناء منزلها الأمامي، لا يمكن لـ"لسندس" اجتياز الحارس، "فؤاد". في هذه الأثناء، يذهب الدكتور "أبو الأشرار" في لقاء أول آخر، لكنه هذه المرة مستعد لإطلاق "آلة الحب" عند أبسط تلميح سيسوء وضع الموعد. تُعرض في الحلقة أغنية "حب شرير" التي غنتها "شينا ايستون". Don't Even Blink/ Chez Platypus
Candace is more determined than ever to expose her brothers’ antics, so she decides to find out where their wild creations disappear to. Even Phineas and Ferb are curious, so with the assistance of their neighborhood friends, they try to help Candace solve the mystery. However, Dr. Doofenshmirtz's invisibility ray machine puts a kink in Candace's quest to bust her brothers./ Phineas and Ferb open Chez Platypus, a chic Platypus-themed restaurant that becomes the trendiest restaurant in town. Jeremy finally asks Candace on a dinner date to Chez Platypus, and despite the fact that the restaurant is in her own front yard, Candace can't get past the doorman, Buford. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz goes on another blind date, but this time he is prepared to unleash his "de-love-inator" at the slightest hint that his date is going south. The episode features the song "Evil Love," performed by Sheena Easton.

To impress her new friend, Tilly claims she saw stone gargoyles come to life. Cricket makes a deal to sell Bill's produce to a major grocery chain.

programme.title: "هامستر" و"غريتل" - Hamster & Gretel
programme.desc:
مقلد القصص المصورة/الرجل الحصان
يجب على "هامستر" و"غريتل" هزيمة قط شرير مستوحى من الكتب المصورة. يواجه "هامستر" و"غريتل" شريرًا نصفه رجل ونصفه حصان يحب الاحتفال. Comic Shop Copycat/ Neigh, It Ain't So!
Hamster and Gretel must defeat a comic book inspired cat villain; Hamster and Gretel face a half-man-half-horse villain who loves to party.

programme.title: "هامستر" و"غريتل" - Hamster & Gretel
programme.desc:
حفلة عودة المتخرجين/دكتور إيلغود
يجب على "هامستر" و"غريتل" إنقاذ رقصة بداية العام الدراسي في المدرسة الثانوية؛ يواجه "هامستر" و"غريتل" ثعبان بحر به طفرة. Saturday Homecoming Fever/ Dr. Eelgood
Hamster and Gretel must save the homecoming dance at the high school; Hamster and Gretel encounter a mutant eel.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
"ستيمبنكس" / ليست نزهة
حينما يكتشف "فارس" و"فادي" عملة تذكارية من معرض "دانفيل" لعام 1903، يذهبان مباشرة إلى المهرجان حيث تم اختراع الأجهزة التي تعمل بالبخار، وبعض الأطفال، الذين يشبهونهما، كانوا يحضّرون من أجل الحدث المنتظر. تخطط "جميلة" نزهة من أجل "فارس" حينما تخطط المجموعة خططًا خاصة بهم. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يستخدم جهاز يرسل إبنته إلى ماراثون من الأفلام. Steampunx/ It's No Picnic
When Phineas and Ferb discover a commemorative coin from the 1903 Danville World's Fair, they're immediately taken back to the festival where steam-driven devices were introduced and a set of kids, who were very much like them, were preparing for the highly anticipated event./ Isabella plans an impromptu picnic for Phineas when the rest of the gang have plans of their own. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz uses a Teleport-inator to send his daughter to a movie marathon.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
البلدة الثلاثية المرعبة، ثلاثية الرعب
في هذه الحلقة الجديدة من "فارس" و"فادي" تحدث ثلاث قصص. القصة الأولى، "سندس" تفعل سحرًا عن طريقة الخطأ والذي يحول "داكي مومو" إلى دمية حقيقية والتي تتعقبها. في القصة الثانية، "أبو الأشرار" يواجه عملاقًا أسطوريًا وهو رأس طفل كبيرة والتي تحقق الأماني، في القصة الثالثة، "فارس" و"فادي" والأصدقاء يواجهون حشد كبير من خلد الماء والذي يحاول تدمير البلدة. Terrifying Tri-State Trilogy of Terror
This new episode of "Phineas and Ferb" features three separate tales. Tale One follows Candace as she accidentally conjures up a spell that turns her Ducky Momo plushie into a living, breathing doll that is set on stalking her. In Tale Two, Doofenshmirtz encounters a mythological, giant floating baby head that grants cursed wishes; and Tale Three pits Phineas, Ferb and their friends against a horde of mischievous, evil platypuses set on destroying the town.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
"دروسلشتاينوين" / واجه مخاوفك
"دروسلشتاينوين"، حينما تعلم "فانيسا" أن "أبو الأشرار" قد ورث قلعة "دروسلشتاينوين " بجانبها، تغتنم الفرصة لإقامة أفضل حفل هالوين. البلدة كلها هناك مع "فادي" وفارس" واللذان يأديان دور مخططين الحفل وعازفين الموسيقى. في هذه الأثناء، "أبو الأشرار" يستعين بمساعدة "بيري" لإيجاد كنز كبير ومخفيّ، والذي تركته له عمته في مكان ما في القلعة. "واجه مخاوفك" - بعد دراسة استمرت لساعات لأفلام الرعب، "أبو الأشرار" يطور نظرية بأن تكبير الحيوانات الأليفة الجميلة الصغيرة إلى وحوش عملاقة سيساعده في السيطرة على البلدة. لكني حينما ينفذ خطته، يدرك أن الأمر ربما أكبر منه. في هذه الأثناء، "فارس" و"فادي" يبتكران مدينة كبيرة من الرغاوي ليقوما بخدع التزلج، وجولة "سندس" في معمل "دانفيل" الفضائي تعطيها الفرصة لتقنية عالية. Drusselsteinoween/Face Your Fear
“Druselsteinoween” - When Vanessa learns that Doofenshmirtz has inherited a Drusselsteinian castle right next door to her, she seizes the opportunity to throw the biggest Halloween bash ever. The whole town is there, including Phineas and Ferb, who act as the event’s party planners and DJs. Meanwhile, Doofenshmirtz enlists Perry to help him find a large, hidden treasure that his Great Aunt has placed somewhere within the castle. “Face Your Fear” - After studying hours of horror movies, Doofenshmirtz develops a theory that enlarging small, cute animals into giant beasts will help him take over the Tri-State area. But when he puts his plan into action, he realizes it might be too much for him to handle. Meanwhile, Phineas and Ferb make a giant revolving foam city so they can safely perform skateboarding tricks, and Candace’s tour of the Danville Space Laboratory gives her an opportunity for a high-tech bust.

programme.title: "هامستر" و"غريتل" - Hamster & Gretel

When Candace is accidentally zapped into the game, Phineas and Ferb have to bring her back in time for her cotillion. Meanwhile, Dr. Doofenshmirtz creates a machine that puts all men in the Tri-State area in ball gowns so that he looks masculine by comparison.

Chronicles of Meap, The (Part 1 and 2)

While they are busy trying to repair it, Candace discovers Meap, an alien she believes has been "roboticized" by Phineas and Ferb, and sets out to bust her brothers with the evidence in hand. Meanwhile, Phineas, Ferb and Isabella are captured by Mitch, a rogue alien whom Meap was tracking before his spacecraft crashed. Candace and Meap team up to save them, while Dr. Doofenshmirtz's battle with Perry lands them right in the middle of the rescue plan.

programme.title: فينيس وفيرب - Phineas And Ferb

In fact, older sister Mandy has two younger brothers, Thaddeus and Thor, who drive her crazy with their ambitious projects. Although Candace and Mandy initially bond, they soon compete, urging their brothers to build the best backyard fort. Dr. Doofenshmirtz is doing his part to be green by using recycled materials to build an "Evaporator-inator" to dry up all the pools in the Tri-State area. programme.desc:
حشرة على الحائط / مركبتي العزيزة
في الجزء الأول، "سندس" تتحول إلى حشرة بسبب عبث "فؤاد" بأحد اختراعات "فارس" و"فادي". بسبب حجمها الصغير، تتمكن من التصنت على "سامي" لمعرفة إلى أين سيصطحبها في موعدهما، لكنها تفهم المعلومة على نحو خطأ. "بيري" يساعد "أبو الأشرار" في استعادة طبيعته الخلاقة بعد اعتراف "أبو الأشرار" أنه يواجه صعوبات مؤخرًا في اختراع أجهزة شريرة. في الجزء الثاني، "فارس" و"فادي" يحاولان إصلاح سيارة أبيهما في موعد عرض سيارات "دو وب هوب". في هذه الأثناء، "اللواء منير" يحضر عرض السيارات ليحاول معرفة من يواعد إبنه "مونتي". هل سينكشف سر "مونتي" و"فانيسا"؟ Fly on the Wall/ My Sweet Ride
In the first segment, Candace is accidentally turned into a fly due to Buford tinkering with one of Phineas and Ferb's inventions. Because of her tiny size, she is able to eavesdrop on Jeremy to hear where he's taking her on their date, but she misinterprets the information. Also, Perry helps Dr. Doofenshmirtz to regain his creative edge after Doofenshmirtz admits that lately he hasn't been able to come up with any good ideas for evil inators. In the second segment, Phineas and Ferb help restore Dad's old car for Candace just in time for the Doo Wop Hop car show. Meanwhile, Major Monogram attends the car show to try to figure out who his son, Monty, is dating. Will Monty and Vanessa's secret be revealed?

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
من أجل الثلج فقط / عام جديد سعيد!
في الجزء الأول، "جيرمي" يؤمن بأن "سندس" معجبة بالهوكي، مما يدفع "سندس" و"زهرة" لتعلم اللعبة. في هذه الأثناء، "فارس" و"فادي" يبتكران نسخة جديدة من لعبة الهوكي، لكي تُلعب أثناء استراحة المباراة، و"بيري" يحاول إيقاف "أبو الأشرار" من تطوير جهاز شرير، والذي سيحول الهدف إلى شيء أكبر وأكثر إخافة من هيئته الأساسية. / في الجزء الثاني، "فارس" و"فادي" يبتكران نوعًا من الكرات والذي سيسيقط من الفضاء حين منتصف الليل في عشية السنة الجديدة. "سندس" تقرر قرارًا للعام الجديد بأن تكف عن النيل من أخويها لكن لديها ساعة كاملة قبل أن ينتهي العام من أجل الوصل إلى هدفها. في هذه الأثناء، "بيري" يحاول إيقاف "أبو الأشرار" من التلاعب بقرارات السنة الجديدة لسكان بلدة "دانفيل". For Your Ice Only/ Happy New Year!
In the first segment, Jeremy believes Candace to be a hockey fan, prompting Candace and Stacy to go to elaborate lengths to learn about the game. Meanwhile, Phineas and Ferb devise an exciting new version of hockey, to be played during the break of a local hockey game, and Perry sets out to stop Doctor Doofenshmirtz from developing "The Abonimable-inator," which would transform its target into a bigger and scarier version of itself./In the second segment, Phineas and Ferb devise a type of ball that will drop from space at the stroke of midnight on New Year's Eve. Candace has made a New Year's resolution to stop trying to bust her brothers, but still has a whole hour before the year is over to accomplish her goal. Meanwhile, Perry tries to stop Dr. Doofenshmirtz from manipulating the New Year's resolutions of the people of Danville.

programme.title: فارس و فادي - Phineas And Ferb
programme.desc:
إخفاق "بولي" / حساء الفناء الخلفي
في الجزء الأول، "سندس" تتحدى "فؤاد" في النيل من أخويها عن طريق عدم اختفاء اختراعهما اليومي لكي تراه الأم. في هذه الأثناء، الولدان يحتفلان بالنظافة ببناء كرة تنظيف أسناس كبيرة، و"أبو الأشرار" يشرب الكثير من الكافيين. في الجزء الثاني، "فارس" يحاول إيجاد حل لمخلفات اختراعاته السابقة، والذي يجعل المجموعة تبني وعاءً للاختراعات. في هذه الأثناء، الأم تواجه مشاكلًا في النوم أثناء إعدادها لفطائر من أجل حدث، و"أبو الأشرار" يحاول أن يسبب العمى للبدلة بأكملها. Bully Bust/ Backward Hodge Podge
In the first segment, Candace challenges Buford to take on the task of busting her brothers by making sure that their daily invention doesn't disappear just as Mom is about to see it. Meanwhile, the boys celebrate oral hygiene by building a giant Dental Hygienoshpere, and Dr. Doofenshmirtz consumes too much caffeine. In the second segment, Phineas tries to figure out what to do with the leftover materials from past inventions and big ideas, which leads to the gang building an "invention casserole." Meanwhile, Mom fights some serious sleep deprivation while baking pies for an event, and Dr. Doofenshmirtz attempts to temporarily blind the entire Tri-State area.

programme.title: Miraculous الدعسوقة والهر الأسود - Miraculous Tales Of Ladybug & Cat Noir
programme.desc:
Catalyst (Heroes' Day - Part One)
It’s Heroes’ Day in Paris and everyone must do a good deed. But Marinette hasn’t had time to take care of hers, overwhelmed by her missions as Ladybug. Afraid that she’ll disappoint her friends if she tells them that she hasn’t planned anything, Marinette lies to them and quickly gets submerged by her own lies. But the nightmare is just beginning, as Hawk Moth akumatizes his assistant Nathalie into Catalyst, a supervillain who will allow him to put the plan he’s been preparing for so long into action… a plan that should allow him to finally defeat Ladybug and Cat Noir… Catalyst (Heroes' day - Part 1)
Catalyst - Heroes' Day Part One: It’s Heroes’ Day. Everyone must do a good deed. The day becomes a nightmare when Hawk Moth akumatizes Nathalie into Catalyst to activate a plan.

programme.title: Miraculous الدعسوقة والهر الأسود - Miraculous Tales Of Ladybug & Cat Noir
programme.desc:
Mayura (Heroes' Day - Part Two)
With Catalyst’s help, Hawk Moth has turned into Scarlet Moth and finally put his dreadful plan into action by reakumatizing all his former villains! To face them, Ladybug and Cat Noir end up at the head of a team of superheroes made up of Rena Rouge, Queen Bee and Carapace. But the heroes aren’t used to working together and quickly realize that they lack training. Very soon, they find themselves in an extremely difficult situation and are about to get defeated by Scarlet Moth… Will the team of superheroes manage to defeat Scarlet Moth and his incredible army of supervillains? Will Heroes’ Day triumph… or will it turn into Villains’ Day? Mayura (Heroes' day - Part 2)
